title: Deductible Layer of a BizFlood Policy on Contents Payments — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Other-insurance note for contents payments on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) where the named insured's BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) schedule the address with a contents value.

**Rule.** The other flood policy's deductible layer a contents payment uses is settled as follows: when that BizFlood policy schedules the address with a contents value and the building is in flood zone V or VE, it is the BizFlood tier's V-zone deductible percentage of the location's value at the time of loss, never less than the BizFlood tier's V-zone minimum deductible, that value being the one on that policy's adjuster's latest report for the location and the date of loss and, when its adjuster has filed no report for them, the building and contents values its statement of values schedules for the location added together; when that BizFlood policy schedules the address with a contents value and the building is outside flood zones V and VE, it is that BizFlood policy's flat deductible per location; otherwise no other flood policy's deductible applies and the layer is the sum of the building limit and the contents limit, so the whole sworn contents amount is carried alone.

**Policy and location.** That BizFlood policy is the named insured's BizFlood policy that schedules the building's address, in force on the date of loss and not written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program. The building's location on that BizFlood policy is the location number its statement of values gives the building's address.

## Records read

From the BizFlood records: the statement of values entry for the address (location number, building value, contents value), the BizFlood adjuster's latest report for that location and date of loss, and the BizFlood tier's V-zone deductible percentage, V-zone minimum deductible and the policy's flat deductible per location; from this policy, the building's flood zone and its building and contents limits.

## Input — judgement — output

| Contents value scheduled by that BizFlood policy | Flood zone | Layer |
|---|---|---|
| declared | V or VE | V-zone deductible percentage of the location's value at the time of loss, at least the V-zone minimum deductible |
| declared | outside V and VE | flat deductible per location |
| not declared, or no such BizFlood policy | any | this policy's building limit plus contents limit |

**Location value (hypothetical).** No BizFlood adjuster report for the location; statement of values building value 500,000 and contents value 140,000: the location value is 640,000.
